description: Set an explicit browser viewport for responsive or breakpoint testing. Uses the selected page, or the first page controlled by this room when none is selected. Before any controlled page exists, records one pending override for the first page. Width is clamped to 240..4096 and height to 160..4096. Otherwise leave the viewport unset; reset temporary overrides before finishing unless asked to keep them. Supply target_id to act on that exact already-owned page independently of the selected or displayed tab. Omit target_id to use the selected tab. With no selected or explicit target, a pending viewport intent is allowed only when the owned context has no pages.

target_id.description: Exact already-owned page returned by browser.tabs or browser.tab_new. This does not select, show, create, or focus that page.
